notes: Fixture palette — invented, so nothing here derives from third-party art. The OCEAN ramp runs pale-at-depth, like the real Terraqueous diverging ramp, and this is load-bearing rather than decorative: the defect the polar rule exists to fix is that blank page is nearest to the DEEPEST-ocean swatch, which can only happen when the deepest swatch is pale. 'paper_rgb' [232,230,218] sits 39.2 units from band 0 and 100 from the next-nearest band, mirroring the real map's 40.6 / 38.3 — close enough to band 0 that no colour threshold separates them, which is the whole point, and bright enough (luminance 227) to stay clear of the ink test. Paper is NOT a classification swatch; see worldgen/lut.py. 'ink_rgb' is not part of the ElevationLUT schema either; make_source.py reads it to paint the label/graticule strokes. It is deliberately nearest the 'mountain' swatch and dark (luminance 65), the same relationship the real Terraqueous label red has to the real >7000 m swatch — so the fixture reproduces the failure mode rather than a caricature of it.
